name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.334.0 — One suite run per tree: a run cache keyed by the content tree lets the build, fan-out and review drivers reuse a green gate or suite for an unchanged tree; the gate resolves {testFiles} to the File Plan's exact test files; policy.closeSuite (auto|always) skips the close-time whole-suite run when the close delta is overlay-only and no test reads it; /spec:fix workers run only their named test file and the session runs the gate once. 7.333.0 — a spec's brief stamp is now parsed once into briefed/ad-hoc (lib/brief.js) and relateBriefs is the one comparison, answering same/different/unknown with a reason; the fan-out report no longer blames a stopped ad-hoc lane for a wait it never caused, and the --all 🤷 line names why parallelism is unknown; the new variant-lint.js (spec-paths variant-lint) fails the suite on any .brief read in a boolean, coalescing or equality position outside the helper; test fixtures now default to ad-hoc specs. 7.332.0 — Trim: removed the dead observe-row reader and ci-query --branch mode, unused CLI flags (comment-narration --hosts/--people/--baseline, expire-tests --keep-on-red, red-check --expect-green, secrets-scan --paths, scope-reconcile --dirs, smoke --timeout/--seed, workspace-scan --depth, collision-closure --tests, pictures --no-send, citations-check --verbose, out-of-plan-triage --gate-line, prose-cap --cap), the spec-queue bump/defer/ok tombstone, the adaptation-rules template and the shared-design spec-paths key; folded duplicate helpers into lib/util.js and lib/sync-write; condensed stale comment history. No behaviour change on any live path.
